checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate square images, not a collage
Same sage-green mug in all three
must.why: Straight cylindrical mug with a C handle and matte sage glaze in each. The breakfast mug is a slightly deeper green and looks a bit taller and narrower.

must.item: Main image shows whole mug on pure white
must.why: The whole mug is shown on a white background with a soft shadow. The background is near-white, not perfectly pure.

must.item: Lifestyle image places mug naturally on cosy breakfast table
must.why: Wooden table with toast, jam, linen, window light and steam.

must.item: Detail image focuses on rim and glaze
must.why: Macro of the rim and matte glaze. It is rather soft and blurry.

faults.what: The close-up is soft and out of focus. The glaze texture is not crisp, and the shot is cropped so tightly that it is hard to read as a mug.
The mug in the breakfast shot is a slightly darker, more saturated green with slightly different proportions.
The close-up has a grey-white background, and the white shot has a faint off-white vignette.
The steam in the breakfast shot looks a little artificial.

summary: Three clean, separate square photos of a matching sage mug: white studio, cosy breakfast table and rim close-up. The close-up is soft and the green shifts slightly between shots.
